sentences.text:
DATED 16/04/2024 IN WP NO.102039/2024, PASSED BY THE LEARNED SINGLE JUDGE IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY AND ETC.,
 THIS WRIT APPEAL, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING THIS DAY, ORDER WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:

CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  AND  THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE B. MURALIDHARA PAI  ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.I.ARUN) The instant writ appeal is filed challenging the order, dated 16.04.2024, passed by this Court in Writ Petition No.102039/2024.
2.

It is submitted by the learned Additional Advocate General that the lands of the respondents have been acquired and the lis pertains to the amount of compensation payable to the respondent;
however, subsequent to filing of the writ appeal, there has been a Consent Award passed and the amount is also deposited.
In the light of it, it is submitted that the writ appeal becomes infructuous.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:1496-DB HC-KAR 3.
For the aforementioned reason, the writ appeal is hereby dismissed as having become infructuous.
In view of the dismissal of the appeal, pending interlocutory applications, if any, stand disposed of as not surviving for consideration.

Sd/-
(M.I.ARUN) JUDGE Sd/-
